dialogues.speaker: Savinien
dialogues.text: Nope, this sum is final. Not one Mora less.

dialogues.speaker: Ligniere
dialogues.text: I know you're very good, but this is 50% higher than the cost of hiring a regular duelist to be your champion, and then some!

dialogues.speaker: Savinien
dialogues.text: This is what they call the "kinship fee."

dialogues.speaker: Ligniere
dialogues.text: Wh—What? What kinship? And what's that gotta do with the price?

dialogues.speaker: Savinien
dialogues.text: I've investigated, you know. The person you intend to have me duel is a cousin of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Savinien
dialogues.text: Familial disputes are very tricky. If you can't afford me, then I'll...

dialogues.speaker: Ligniere
dialogues.text: Alright, alright! Wait a moment, let me reconsider!
